verdict.rationale: Tavily's own Extract endpoint returns full web page content for one URL or up to 20 URLs per request, with an explicit "format": "markdown" option, and per-URL failures are reported separately. Crawl adds built-in extraction across a whole site, and both are exposed in the SDKs, CLI and MCP. A developer can therefore get full text or markdown for result URLs rather than just snippets. Missing for 10: evidence that search results themselves can include full raw content inline (the pack shows only that `results[].content` generation is tunable), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.
